acv.quote: It would have been about seventy-five K a year.

header.reason: Diane, the CFO, froze all new vendor projects after a missed Q3. Nobody showed her what homegrown billing cost, so it looked 'nice to have'. Renee calls it timing alone.

findings.label: What started it
findings.finding: Lead with how long pricing changes take, not billing features.

line.text: Monetize faster with Stripe Billing. Manage pricing, reduce churn, and grow revenue on one platform

findings.why: Owen reached out because every pricing change on their homegrown billing took a quarter.
findings.quote: every pricing change takes them a quarter

findings.label: Who decided
findings.finding: Tell finance what keeping homegrown billing costs them each year.
findings.why: Diane, the CFO, froze the deal, and Renee never spoke to her.
findings.quote: Owen told me. I never spoke to her.

findings.label: The competitor
findings.finding: Name the cost of doing nothing, since no rival vendor was involved.
findings.why: Renee says Owen looked at no one else, but late on his questions turned to payback.
findings.quote: do you have something that shows payback?

findings.label: Our message
findings.finding: Change billing pitch from growing revenue to freeing roadmap time.

line.text: Monetize faster with Stripe Billing. Manage pricing, reduce churn, and grow revenue on one platform

findings.why: Owen loved the demo but pushed back when Renee said billing would grow revenue.
findings.quote: we're not trying to grow revenue with billing

findings.label: Missing proof
findings.finding: Add a cost model: engineering time, billing errors, failed-card lapses.
findings.why: Renee sent the general ROI deck, and Owen said it would not get past Diane.
findings.quote: I can't get this past Diane without a number that's ours.

findings.label: Their words
findings.finding: Say billing stops being 'a tax on the roadmap'.

line.text: Financial infrastructure to grow your revenue

findings.why: This was Owen's own phrase for what homegrown billing does to his product team.
